text:
ashley: Planning to enable lumen-3b-q4f16 in the model-catalog tomorrow during the low-traffic change window. Canary plan: 1% EU -> 10% global over ~2h. Need fallback ordering review, pin list, and release notes link: <https://redwood.internal/release/lumen-3b-enable|release notes>
jamie: quick Q — what's the fallback ladder for this? quant -> fp16 -> smaller model?
ashley: Fallback order proposed: lumen-3b-q4f16 -> lumen-3b-q4f8 -> lumen-3b-fp16 -> lumen-2-strong. TTL on fallback entries: 600s. We'll pin the q4f16 variant for the canary.
mike: latency concerns — perf run last night showed ~+20ms p50 in some scenes. Targets?
ashley: target p50 <= 120ms. Perf harness looked like 110ms avg at 128 tokens. If p50 > 150ms or errors spike >0.3% we rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by ashley: catalog.enable model=lumen-3b-q4f16 canary=1% region=eu start=2025-09-01T05:00:00Z window=3h (id=db-3172)
elaine: ops note — infra patch was scheduled at 04:30 in EU, will collide. Can we shift start to 05:00?
ashley: yes we can shift to 05:00 UTC. @jamie can you still run the smoke tests and own rollbacks if needed?
jamie: 05:00 works. I'll own smoke checks and post results here. Quick smoke test I'll run right after canary start: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPO_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"lumen-3b-q4f16","input":"Hello world","max_tokens":20}'
```
anika: suggest adding tie-breaker policy: if latency equal prefer lower-cost variant. I'll add that to the catalog policy set.
sre_tom: add autoscale guard: min_instances=2 for canary; circuit-breaker: 20% error rate sustained over 5m => automated rollback. I can wire alert -> ops channel.
jamie: smoke test thresholds: p50 < 150ms, p99 < 700ms, errors < 0.3%. I'll post metrics after each step.
deploy-bot: canary started: 1% EU lumen-3b-q4f16 at 2025-09-01T05:00:00Z. monitoring: /ops/alerts/canary/db-3172
jamie: smoke run #1: p50=118ms, p99=420ms, errors=0.05% :thumbsup:
mike: saw a ~3% token cost increase in perf runs due to q4f16 packing differences. Acceptable?
ashley: cost delta <5% is acceptable for now. We'll monitor for 24h and then decide broader rollout.
elaine: ops update — infra patch rescheduled to 06:00, we'll keep an eye on GPU temps during canary.
deploy-bot: canary expanded to 10% global at 2025-09-01T06:00:00Z. deploy id=db-3172-phase2
jamie: phase2 smoke: p50=125ms, p99=480ms, errors=0.1% — looks green.
anika: updated catalog ordering: priority-map id=pm-20250901 applied. Backup pin: lumen-3b-q4f8 will be auto-pinned for 15m on error triggers.
ashley: great. Planning final cutover to enable 100% on 2025-09-02 during a low-traffic window; will create a follow-up thread for that.
mike: one request — add a short rollback playbook snippet to the release notes showing how to pin the older variant and revoke the enable.
ashley: done, added snippet and a step-by-step in the release notes.
jamie: if alert fires I'll run the rollback script: 
```
./catalogctl pin --model lumen-3b-q4f8 --duration 1h --reason "canary rollback"
```
deploy-bot: canary complete: metrics stable, final status: OK, completed at 2025-09-01T08:00:00Z. Closing thread.
